contextual_baseline.role: prior published bank-1-selected, bank-2-scored torch/best-Triton context only; it is not a threshold or a fresh confirmatory comparison

limitations: This is post-hoc exploratory engineering evidence, not a confirmatory endpoint.
Candidate selection and scoring reuse one bank, so selection optimism is possible.
Only one H100 hardware instance and one fixed 96-workload corpus were measured.
The frozen STOP rule prevented three-bank selection/scoring collection.
The prior 0.627266 value is contextual and comes from a different frozen protocol.

precision_context.conclusion: FP16 reduction mode does not explain the old gap.

protocol.ratio: torch median milliseconds / selected candidate median milliseconds
